explanation: The wrapper locates the 1-based node position. InsertAfter first links the new node to the selected node’s successor, then links the selected node to the new node. Existing nodes are retained.
timeComplexity: O(p) wrapper traversal for position p; O(1) insertion itself.
spaceComplexity: O(1) auxiliary space and one new node.
